query:
INSERT INTO crm_email_backfill_outbox (team_id, user_id, traceparent)
                   SELECT team_id, user_id, $4 FROM crm_email_consent WHERE team_id = $1 AND enabled AND ($3 OR user_id = $2)
                   ON CONFLICT (team_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET requested_at = now(), traceparent = EXCLUDED.traceparent
